verdict.rationale: The product offers a selectable faster "edge transcription" path for short audio, which implies a latency tradeoff, and it says it publishes accuracy results so users can evaluate performance before integrating. However, there is no documented catalog of models, no model-selection parameter, and only a single flat $0.002/min price; the "core" minutes wording hints at tiers without spelling them out. Missing for 10: documented list of selectable transcription models, a per-model accuracy/latency/cost comparison table, an explicit model-selection API parameter, and per-model pricing.
